summary: Created the sandbox workflow expansion initiative from senior-developer feedback, covering broader skill discovery, reproducible workflow benchmarking, plugin-owned scripts, and repository-independent distribution.
Broadened public skill and plugin metadata from coding tasks to isolated, reproducible, or resource-controlled tasks and recorded a 14-case adversarial review.
Specified versioned workflow manifests, result envelopes, comparability rules, safety boundaries, and a credential-free example.
Added standard-library preflight and benchmark helpers with explicit live authorization, authentication checks, bounded execution, redaction, partial results, and failure classification.
Validated a copied plugin from an unrelated working directory and added Linux, macOS, and Windows portability CI plus a fresh-wheel release smoke.
Passed creator validators, full resource-free checks, package build, artifact validation, fresh wheel installation, repository-independent plugin smoke, and exec-plan validation.
